summary: Phase 3 catalogue filter module tested end-to-end on /catalogue/food, /catalogue/hygiene, /catalogue/vitamins and on mobile viewport. All 21 functional checks from the review brief pass: left filter sidebar visible on desktop, pet-type segmented control, brand checkboxes (alphabetical and exact match per shelf), tag checkboxes, featured collapsible group, clear button, sort dropdown (featured / A-Z / Z-A), result count, empty-after-filter state, mobile Sheet drawer with close button and active-filter badge, product card click opens signup modal, regression OK (parent /catalogue page, WhatsApp FAB present, no console errors).
tests_executed: Desktop 1920x1080 /catalogue/food: initial 6/6, brands list Acana/Brit Care/Happy Cat/Hill's Science Plan/Purina Pro Plan/Royal Canin (alphabetical) [PASS]
Pet-type=dog narrows to 3 [PASS]; pet-type=cat narrows to 3 [PASS]; pet-type=all restores 6 [PASS]
Status group collapsed by default; expanding then toggling featured -> 2 cards [PASS]
Brand=Royal Canin + featured=true -> 1 card [PASS]; Brand=Acana + featured=true -> 0 cards with catalogue-food-grid-no-results visible [PASS]
Sort alpha-asc orders Acana->Brit->Happy->Hill's->Purina->Royal [PASS]; alpha-desc reverses [PASS]; featured sort runs without error [PASS]
Tag filter-tag-dry narrows to 2 cards (containing 'dry' tag) [PASS]
/catalogue/hygiene: 6/6 initial, brands Beaphar/Ever Clean/Pet Head/Trixie/TropiClean/Virbac, filter-tag-litter -> 1 card (Ever Clean Multiple Cat Litter) [PASS]

/catalogue/vitamins: 6/6 initial, brands Beaphar/Canina/Nutramax/Trixie/Vetoquinol/VetriScience [PASS]; pet=dog still 6/6 because all seeded vitamin products have pet_type=both (filter logic correctly includes 'both' in dog filter) [INFO not a bug]
/catalogue parent: 3 sub-category links present (/catalogue/food, /hygiene, /vitamins) [PASS]; WhatsApp FAB visible [PASS]; no console errors
Mobile 420x800 /catalogue/food: desktop sidebar hidden, filters-toggle-button visible, clicking opens Sheet drawer containing full filter panel with filters-close-button (verified via screenshot)
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: when the mobile Sheet is open, two filters-panel DOM instances exist (hidden desktop + visible mobile) with the same data-testids on inner controls (filter-pet-type-*, filter-brand-*, etc.). Playwright .click resolves to the first (hidden) element and times out. Consider scoping inner testids inside the sheet (e.g. mobile- prefix) or rendering only one panel at a time — purely a testability nit, not a user-facing bug.
Minor: tag list on /catalogue/food contains both 'sensitive' and 'sensitive-skin' which read awkwardly as separate filters; could be deduped or grouped, but matches the underlying product tags.
Minor: filters-result-count inside the panel and shelf-result-count above the grid duplicate the same info — fine, but worth a quick design check.
Code quality: CatalogueShelf active-filter badge math is repeated twice (lines 135 and 137) — extract to a const for DRY.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 catalogue filter module on /catalogue/{food,hygiene,vitamins} is fully working. All 21 functional acceptance criteria pass on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 420x800 (Sheet drawer verified via screenshot). One Playwright-only caveat: when the mobile Sheet is open, the hidden desktop sidebar still has matching data-testids on inner controls, so selectors target two elements — use page.locator(...).last() or scope by Sheet root in any future scripts. Vitamins seed data appears to have all products as pet_type='both' (pet=dog filter returns 6/6) which is correct behaviour by the filter logic, not a bug.
